blocks.raw: <ExamTip>LEA questions frequently present floor plan scenarios and ask you to identify the most appropriate location for a mechanical room, electrical room, or fire escape stair. These are integration questions: they require knowledge of MEPF space requirements (from the MEPF subject), fire egress rules (RA 9514), and architectural planning principles (service zones at the building's perimeter or core) all applied simultaneously.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Callout>This is why Architectural Design is saved for comprehensive review rather than early study. It is the subject where all your other preparation lands. If you haven't covered the codes, the structures, the services, and the laws first, you cannot bring them to bear on design decisions. Build the foundation subjects first, then let Architectural Design become the place where they integrate.</Callout>
